question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer "**representative**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage refers to the concept of democracy in the country.
 
• In the context of the given question, it is likely that the blank is referring to a type of government or leadership, where individuals are elected to represent the people.
 
• Therefore, the correct word to use in the blank is "representative."
 
 
• Grammatically, "representative" is a noun that can be used to refer to someone who acts on behalf of others or a group.(प्रतिनिधि)
 
 
• Example: Employees from each department elect a representative.
 
 
 
 
 
• The other options, such as "rulers" and "dictators", imply a more authoritarian style of leadership, while "peasants" is not relevant in the given context.

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "rulers", refers to individuals who have power or authority over others, often in a monarchy or dictatorship.(शासक)
 
• Option 2, "peasants", refers to poor farmers or agricultural workers.(किसान)
 
• Option 4, "dictators", refers to individuals who have absolute power and control over a country or group of people.(तानाशाह)
